name: GDevelop
description_en: 🎮 Open-source, cross-platform 2D/3D/multiplayer game engine designed for everyone.
readme_excerpt: GDevelop is a full-featured, no-code, open-source game development software. You can build 2D, 3D and multiplayer games for mobile (iOS, Android), desktop and the web. GDevelop is designed to be fast and incredibly intuitive: make games using an easy-to-understand yet powerful event-based system and modular behaviors.
